column1: # The fork's packages: AndroidX's package -> the package the fork declares it in. A subpackage
# follows its parent. Applied to upstream's side before comparing, both to a file's text (package
# statements, imports, qualified names, KDoc links and `@sample` references) and to its path under
# a source root (`androidx/compose/remote/creation/compose/…` is compared with
# Only packages the fork declares are listed. `androidx.compose.remote.core` and the rest of
# `androidx.compose.remote.creation` stay AndroidX's: the fork does not carry them.
# The last row is the writer's package. Upstream has no package of that name (its classes are
# reached through upstream-fqn.tsv); the row is the name the fork's writer had while the fork was in
# AndroidX's package, kept so that imports sort where they did.
